support.heading: Need help?
support.message: If you run into any issues during onboarding, email our support team.

screens.title: Connect Paycor to Dynamis
messages: Hi! I'll walk you through connecting your Paycor account to Dynamis.
Once connected, your data flows into Dynamis each pay period. Your TPA can review it there, and it's aggregated to build your year-end census.
You may receive your invitation to join in a few different ways. Either way, it's 4 steps from here.

screens.title: Enter Your Provider
messages: After you receive your invitation, you'll land on the provider selection page.
Enter the name of your provider. The system will show you all possible matches.
Select the correct match for your provider, then click **Connect your Payroll**.

image.alt: Provider selection page with “Paycor” entered and the Connect your Payroll button below it

screens.note: Payroll system not listed? Email support@dynamistpa.com.

screens.title: Approve Permissions
messages: Next, approve the permissions that allow your data to be shared.
Dynamis uses Finch as the payroll aggregator to retrieve your data and pass it to Dynamis.

image.alt: Two Finch permission request screens, followed by the Connect your Paycor account screen

screens.title: Log in to Paycor
messages: Enter your Email and Password in Paycor.
Once you've logged in, the connection between Dynamis and Paycor is complete. Compliance data will begin to be securely shared with your TPA.

image.alt: Paycor Welcome sign-in screen with a username field and Continue button

screens.title: Confirmation Screen
messages: Once complete, you'll see a screen confirming that you've finished the connection process.

image.alt: Laptop showing the confirmation screen: “Your organization's payroll is now connected!”

screens.title: You're connected
messages: That's everything. You've finished connecting Paycor to Dynamis.
